UserPromptSubmit.command: [ "${PLANNING_DISABLED:-}" = "1" ] && exit 0; if [ -f task_plan.md ]; then echo '[planweft] ACTIVE PLAN — current state:'; head -50 task_plan.md; echo ''; echo '=== recent progress ==='; tail -20 progress.md 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?Z/T00:00:00Z/g; s/T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?([+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})/T00:00:00\2/g'; echo ''; echo '[planweft] Read findings.md for research context. Continue from the current phase.'; fi
UserPromptSubmit.description: Inject plan context on every user message for session recovery after /clear

PreToolUse.description: Read plan before tool use to keep goals in active context

PostToolUse.command: [ "${PLANNING_DISABLED:-}" = "1" ] && exit 0; if [ -f task_plan.md ]; then echo '[planweft] Update progress.md with what you just did. If a phase is now complete, update task_plan.md status.'; fi
PostToolUse.description: Remind agent to update progress and plan status after file changes

Stop.description: Check all phases are complete before the agent stops
